key_insight: SpeechParaling-Bench expands paralinguistic evaluation from under 50 to over 100 fine-grained features and pairs them with a >1,000-sample English–Chinese parallel speech set, enabling more objective, cross-lingual assessment of expressive speech generation in LALMs.
problem_solved: It tackles limited feature coverage and subjective, coarse evaluation of paralinguistic cues in large audio-language models, making paralinguistic fidelity measurable and comparable.
method: Define and operationalize 100+ fine-grained paralinguistic features (e.g., affect, prosody, emphasis, speaking style).
Assemble and annotate a >1,000-sample English–Chinese parallel speech corpus aligned to these features.
Provide benchmark tasks, evaluation protocols, and metrics to quantify paralinguistic fidelity in speech generation models.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a standardized, fine-grained toolkit to evaluate and improve expressive and cross-lingual speech generation, accelerating development of more natural, paralinguistic-aware LALMs.
visual_elements: Bar chart comparing feature coverage: <50 (prior) vs 100+ (SpeechParaling-Bench).
Schematic of the benchmark pipeline: feature taxonomy → parallel corpus → annotation → evaluation metrics.
Radar/spider chart showing model performance across representative paralinguistic feature groups (prosody, emotion, emphasis, style).
Map/infographic showing English–Chinese parallel dataset composition and sample counts.
paper_title: SpeechParaling-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Paralinguistic-Aware Speech Generation
paper_authors: Ruohan Liu, Shukang Yin, Tao Wang, Dong Zhang, Weiji Zhuang
